headline_marked: Tawhid Hridoy [[hits double century]] against South Africa 'A'
headline: Tawhid Hridoy hits double century against South Africa 'A'
summary: The Bangladesh 'A' skipper joins an elite list of batters to score a first-class double ton abroad, alongside Shakib Al Hasan and Mushfiqur Rahim.
details: Bangladesh 'A' captain Tawhid Hridoy scored a brilliant double century against South Africa 'A' during the second four-day match at NWC Oval in Potchefstroom.
Hridoy reached his milestone off 335 balls, hitting 22 fours and a six. This marks his second double century in first-class cricket.
With this feat, the 24-year-old joins an elite group of Bangladeshi batters to score first-class double centuries abroad, including Mushfiqur Rahim, Shakib Al Hasan, and Shahriar Hossain.
Hridoy also shared a significant 185-run partnership for the sixth wicket with Mohammad Saifuddin, who scored 87 before being dismissed on the final delivery of the day.
Another teammate, Jaker Ali, narrowly missed a century, finishing his innings with 94 runs off 168 balls.
At the end of the day's play, Bangladesh 'A' reached 471 for six, trailing South Africa 'A's first-innings total of 512 by 41 runs.
caption:
A masterclass in Potchefstroom! Tawhid Hridoy joins the elite list of Bangladeshi batters with a massive double century.

Bangladesh 'A' captain Tawhid Hridoy scored a brilliant double century against South Africa 'A' during the second four-day match at NWC Oval in Potchefstroom.

Hridoy reached his milestone off 335 balls, hitting 22 fours and a six. This marks his second double century in first-class cricket.

With this feat, the 24-year-old joins an elite group of Bangladeshi batters to score first-class double centuries abroad, including Mushfiqur Rahim, Shakib Al Hasan, and Shahriar Hossain.

Hridoy also shared a significant 185-run partnership for the sixth wicket with Mohammad Saifuddin, who scored 87 before being dismissed on the final delivery of the day.

Another teammate, Jaker Ali, narrowly missed a century, finishing his innings with 94 runs off 168 balls.

At the end of the day's play, Bangladesh 'A' reached 471 for six, trailing South Africa 'A's first-innings total of 512 by 41 runs.

headline_marked: Power and Energy Minister [[Iqbal Hasan Mahmud admitted to hospital]]
headline: Power and Energy Minister Iqbal Hasan Mahmud admitted to hospital
summary: The minister was moved to the Coronary Care Unit (CCU) of Ibrahim Cardiac Hospital in Dhaka after suffering from fever, cold, and cough.
details: Power and Energy Minister Iqbal Hasan Mahmud was admitted to the Coronary Care Unit (CCU) of Ibrahim Cardiac Hospital in Dhaka on Tuesday night.
According to his personal assistant, Abdullah Kayes, the minister had been suffering from fever, cold, and cough since Tuesday evening.
He was first brought to the emergency department of the hospital around 10:30 PM before being transferred to the CCU.
The minister's current health status is being monitored by medical professionals at the cardiac specialty hospital.
caption:
Power and Energy Minister Iqbal Hasan Mahmud has been admitted to the CCU of a Dhaka hospital.

Power and Energy Minister Iqbal Hasan Mahmud was admitted to the Coronary Care Unit (CCU) of Ibrahim Cardiac Hospital in Dhaka on Tuesday night.

According to his personal assistant, Abdullah Kayes, the minister had been suffering from fever, cold, and cough since Tuesday evening.

He was first brought to the emergency department of the hospital around 10:30 PM before being transferred to the CCU.

The minister's current health status is being monitored by medical professionals at the cardiac specialty hospital.
